outcome.technical: drive-phase.py: lint_probe() no longer runs a hard-coded tools/prove-gates.py. The plan names it in meta.buildCommands.lintProbe (LINT_PROBE_KEY), resolved through _evidence_io.resolved_commands, with `--changed <shlex-quoted paths>` appended, run under _proc_group.shell_invocation in a process group. A plan with no key appends the did-clause `lintProbe unset` and runs nothing (R5). The hold stores {head, word}, word being 'green' or 'ran none'. A held re-entry prints `lint probe <word> (held)`, and a hold with no word is not reused (R3). New SIGNOFF_STEP_SECONDS = 3600 is the drive's one bound for a sign-off step: phase_gate now passes it to run-test-gate.py as --timeout (the same value as that script's default), and the probe is held to it. On timeout the process tree is torn down (_proc_group.tear_down/drain) and the stop names the timeout and the bound (R7). checkout_status() now returns {path: (letters, sha256 of bytes)}, and status_moved() compares both. The stop names what moved and says 'a mutation it did not restore, or another session's edit ... Put back only what the probe left' instead of 'restore the tree' (R6). Byte budget (R4): the clauses are `lint probe green|ran none`, `lint probe <word> (held)` and `lintProbe unset`. Two fixed texts were shortened to make room: the `done` rule became 'Report where it landed, and whether that is the development branch.' and the not-fast-forward line became 'the parent moved, so nothing merged (...)'. Measured on the lp fixtures, the largest prints are done 284/287 bytes and not-fast-forward with the probe 298. tests/test_drive_phase.py: the stub probe gained hang/touch modes and the fixture sets meta.buildCommands.lintProbe. New cases: lp5 rewritten (unnamed key: no run, did says `lintProbe unset`), lp6 other HEAD is 'b'*40 (R8), lp7 (byte bound over the green, ran-none and not-fast-forward drives with a probe), lp8 (held ran-none round trip), lp9 (hung probe, bound patched to 2 s, stop within 2.06 s), lp10 (pre-modified file rewritten -> stop naming it, no 'restore the tree'; quiet twin with the file left alone -> no stop). PINNED_320_DID's sign-off line gains `lintProbe unset`, with a comment saying why it departs from the 3.2.0 text. phase-signoff.md step 4b rewritten to match. PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md: the generated module map line for drive-phase gains `_proc_group` (an adjacent file outside my declared files; the plan gate allowed the Edit; test__deps g1 was red without it). Gates: `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tests/test_drive_phase.py` exit 0, '1/1 files ok, 578 cases'. Cross-file: test__deps, test__refs, test__help_lints exit 0 (3/3, 560 cases); tools/affected.py + tests/test__affected_tests.py exit 0 (2/2, 63 cases); tools/check-prohibitions.py exit 0; ruff and vermin -t=3.8- clean on both .py files. NOT MINE: tests/test__output_lints.py te11/ln1 are red, naming tests/test__runner_output.py:469 ('a count of the whole set beside a bounded slice'). That file is outside my diff and my files, so I left it unfixed. Dependants: tests/test_drive_phase.py changed (above). tools/affected.py is still correct: its history rows are static, and dropping the module constant LINT_PROBE removes a drive-phase -> tools/prove-gates.py edge the driver no longer has (suite green). PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md changed (module map). README.md and docs/research/pipeline-cost-design.md are still correct: neither describes the probe's path, hold or comparison. hooks/detect-plan-skip.py, record-risk-confirmation.py and stamp-verification.py are still correct: they name drive-phase by basename and read none of lint_probe/checkout_status/LINT_PROBE (git grep). phase-signoff.md dependants (require-plan.py, the schema, _areas, _manifest_io, test__areas, test__refs, test_require_plan, check-prohibitions) are still correct: only step 4b's text changed, and test__areas, test_require_plan, test__refs and check-prohibitions ran green. The names used elsewhere (_counting, _follower_cases, _head, _load, _mark, _marked, _carries, _clip) are unchanged. .github/sweep-costs.json was not re-recorded; lp-block now carries one more drive (the not-fast-forward measurement) and a 2 s timeout case. The orchestrator must still set meta.buildCommands.lintProbe on this repo's plan (e.g. `python3 tools/prove-gates.py`); until then this repo's sign-off says `lintProbe unset`. Note that with meta.phaseGate absent, a new phase's default gate takes every buildCommands key, so lintProbe may need meta.phaseGate.exclude.
outcome.descriptive: The sign-off lint probe is now the plan's declared command. A held run is reported by what it did, prints fit the byte bound with a probe, a hung probe is stopped as a stop, and a pre-modified file the probe rewrote is caught without telling anyone to discard edits.
